title: A photorealistic cinematic vertical mirr
prompt:
A photorealistic cinematic vertical mirror-selfie portrait of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing in a modern tiled bathroom. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with warm neutral undertones and realistic natural skin texture, a softly oval face, delicate tapered jawline, small proportionate nose, naturally shaped soft pink lips, straight dark eyebrows, and dark almond-shaped eyes. One eye and part of her face are partially obscured by the smartphone she is holding, while the visible eye looks toward the phone screen. Her expression is calm, subtly confident, and softly pleasant, with a faint closed-mouth smile.

Her hair is very long, straight, glossy black, falling well past her chest with natural layered ends. It is parted slightly off-center, with long wispy face-framing bangs sweeping across her forehead and alongside her cheeks. Individual strands, realistic shine, and subtle flyaways are visible.

She stands facing the mirror with her torso almost frontal, hips slightly angled and legs comfortably apart. Her right arm is raised, holding a light-colored smartphone vertically in front of the upper-right side of her face, while a simple black hair tie circles her wrist. Her left arm extends downward and slightly outward, with her left hand resting flat on the pale bathroom countertop. She wears exactly a fitted white spaghetti-strap cropped camisole with a low rounded neckline, exposing her midriff, paired with light heather-gray athletic shorts featuring white piping, an elastic waistband, and long white drawstrings hanging at the center. Over the camisole she wears an unbuttoned oversized white long-sleeve shirt, loosely draped from her shoulders with relaxed sleeves and soft fabric folds.

The foreground includes the pale countertop and part of a rectangular sink with a dark faucet. Behind her are beige-gray stone-effect tiled walls, a dark brown wooden bathroom door, a dark doorway recess, a wall switch, and a hanging dark towel. Use warm indoor overhead lighting with soft highlights on the skin and hair, realistic mirror reflections, gentle shadows, and slightly creamy neutral color grading. Capture the scene with a modern smartphone-camera aesthetic, approximately a 26–28mm equivalent lens, moderate depth of field, crisp facial and fabric detail, subtle natural contrast, realistic exposure, and no artificial beauty-filter look. 4:5
